title: Fill a slot from another
prompt: Copy the item in slot 0 into slot 2, leaving slot 0 as it is, and return the array. The array has at least three items.

tests.name: Slot 2 becomes a copy of slot 0

hints: Read one slot and write another in the same line.

docs.name: list[i]
docs.what: The item at position i. Positions start at 0; -1 is the last item.
